about.title: About Us
about.subhead: A friendly neighborhood cafe where great coffee meets good vibes.
paragraphs: Litchfield Perk is a gathering place for our community. We serve freshly brewed coffee, specialty drinks, and baked goods in a warm, welcoming space where everyone feels at home.
Whether you're starting your morning with a latte, meeting friends for a midday break, or grabbing something on the go, we're here to serve you. Stop by and say hello.
